title: Australian MP who lost both legs in alleged car attack discharged from hospital
english: Australian lawmaker Helen Haines has left the hospital following a serious incident last month where she was intentionally struck by a vehicle, resulting in the amputation of her legs. A 43-year-old man has been charged in connection with the attack, though police have not yet determined a clear motive. The event has prompted national concern regarding the safety of public officials and the impact of intense political rhetoric in the country.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያዋ የፓርላማ አባል ሄለን හේንስ ባለፈው ወር በመኪና ሆን ተብሎ ከተገጩ በኋላ ሁለት እግሮቻቸውን አጥተው ለህክምና ሆስፒታል ገብተው የነበረ ሲሆን አሁን ከህክምና ተቋሙ ወጥተዋል። በወንጀሉ የተጠረጠረ አንድ የ43 ዓመት ሰው በቁጥጥር ስር ውሎ ክስ የተመሰረተበት ቢሆንም፣ የጥቃቱ ዓላማ እስካሁን በፖሊስ አልታወቀም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሰዎች ደህንነት እና በፖለቲካዊ ክርክሮች ውስጥ የሚታየው የጥላቻ ንግግር እያስከተለ ስላለው ስጋት በስፋት እንዲወያዩ አድርጓል።
oromo: Miseensi paarlamaa Awustiraaliyaa Helen Heens ji'a darbe konkolaataan yommuu isaan rukutu miila isaanii lamaan erga dhabanii booda gara mana yaalaatti galanii turan, amma garuu mana yaalaa gadi lakkifamaniiru. Namni umuriin isaa 43 ta'e tokko haleellaa kanaan walqabatee himatamee jiraatus, sababni haleellichaa hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane. Ta'ichi kun nageenya qondaaltota mootummaa fi dhiibbaa dubbii cimaa siyaasaa irratti biyyattii keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: Mexican drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo dies age 80
english: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, a notorious Mexican drug kingpin known as the 'Boss of Bosses,' has passed away in a hospital at the age of 80. He famously led the Guadalajara Cartel and revolutionized drug trafficking by establishing major supply routes for Colombian cocaine into the United States during the 1980s. After being imprisoned in 1989 for his involvement in the murder of a DEA agent, he spent his final years under house arrest due to declining health.
amharic: የሜክሲኮው ታዋቂ የዕፅ አዘዋዋሪ ሚጌል አንጄል ፌሊክስ ጋላርዶ በ80 ዓመታቸው በሆስፒታል ህክምና ላይ እያሉ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እርሳቸው በ1980ዎቹ የጓዳላጃራ ካርቴልን በመምራት የኮሎምቢያን ኮኬይን ወደ አሜሪካ በማስገባት የዕፅ ዝውውር ስራውን በማስተባበር ይታወቃሉ። እ.ኤ.አ በ1989 የአሜሪካ የዕፅ መቆጣጠሪያ ወኪልን በመግደል ወንጀል ከታሰሩ በኋላ፣ በጤና መታወክ ምክንያት ባለፉት ጥቂት ዓመታት በእስር ቤት ቁጥጥር ስር ሆነው ሲታከሙ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Gooftaan yakka qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu kan Meksikoo, Miigel Anjeel Feelikis Gaalaardoo, umrii waggaa 80tti hospitaala keessatti du'aniiru. Inni hoogganaa garee yakka 'Guadalajara Cartel' ture; bara 1980ota keessa kokaayinii Kolombiyaa gara Ameerikaatti guuruun daldala dhokataa kana kan jijjiire ture. Bara 1989 keessa ajjeechaa hordoftuu yakka daldala qoricha sammuu (DEA) wajjin walqabatee hidhamanii turan; waggoota dhumaa jireenya isaanii immoo dhukkuba isaaniitiin walqabatee mana hidhaa fi manuma keessatti hordoffii yaalaa godhamaafii turaniiru.

title: Prince Harry praises war veterans on surprise visit to Ukraine
english: Prince Harry made an unannounced trip to Ukraine to visit wounded veterans and support participants of the Invictus Games. During his stay, he toured rehabilitation centers and expressed his admiration for the country's progress in trauma treatment and innovative medical technology. He offered words of encouragement to the service members, highlighting Ukraine's unique expertise in managing modern war injuries.
amharic: ልዑል ሀሪ በዩክሬን ያልተጠበቀ ጉብኝት በማድረግ በጦርነቱ የቆሰሉ ወታደሮችን እና የኢንቪክተስ ጨዋታዎች ተሳታፊዎችን አበረታተዋል። በቆይታቸውም የተሃድሶ ማዕከላትን የጎበኙ ሲሆን፣ ሀገሪቱ በህክምና ዘርፍ እያሳየች ያለውን ፈጠራ እና የችግር አፈታት ክህሎት አድንቀዋል። ልዑሉ ለወታደሮቹ ባስተላለፉት መልእክት በጦርነቱ ድል እንደሚቀዳጁ በመግለጽ ድጋፋቸውን አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Pirensi Haarii gara Yukreen deemee waraana madaayan fi hirmaattota tapha Invictus Games akka tasaa daawwateera. Daawwannaa isaa kanaanis, buufataaleen gargaarsa fayyaa fi teeknooloojii wal'aanummaa haaraa Yukreen fayyadamaa jirtu ilaalchisee dinqisiifannaa isaa ibseera. Pirensichi waraana miidhaan irra gaheef jajjabina kennuun, Yukreen miidhaa waraanaa ammayyaa wal'aanuudhaan sadarkaa olaanaa irra akka jirtu dubbateera.

title: Pope condemns murders of Peru’s Indigenous leaders, deforestation of Amazon
english: During his visit to the Peruvian Amazon, Pope Leo XIV strongly condemned the ongoing destruction of the rainforest and the killing of environmental activists. He criticized the harmful impacts of illegal mining and oil extraction on both the land and local communities. The Pope expressed his full support for Indigenous groups striving to defend their territories and demanded justice for the dozens of leaders murdered for their advocacy.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በፔሩ የአማዞን ደን ያደረጉትን ጉብኝት ተከትሎ፣ የዝናብ ደን መመናመንን እና የአካባቢ ጥበቃ አራማጆች ላይ የሚፈጸመውን ግድያ አውግዘዋል። ህገ-ወጥ የማዕድን ቁፋሮ እና የነዳጅ ዘይት ማውጣት ስራዎች በአካባቢው ላይ እና በአካባቢው ማህበረሰቦች ላይ እያደረሱ ያለውን ጉዳት ተችተዋል። ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳቱ የአገሬው ተወላጆች መሬታቸውን ለመከላከል እያደረጉት ላለው ጥረት ሙሉ ድጋፋቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ለተገደሉ የመብት ተሟጋቾችም ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Pappaan Leo XIV daawwannaa isaan bosona Amaazon kan Peeruu godhaniin, mancaatii bosonaa fi ajjeechaa namoota naannoo eegan irratti raawwatamu cimsanii balaaleffatan. Hojiin al-seeraa kan akka baay'ee baasuu fi boba'aa baasuu naannichaa fi hawaasa naannoo irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiru akka balaaleffatan ibsaniiru. Pappaan kun, lammiileen naannoo lafa isaanii eeggachuuf qabsoo godhan akka deeggaran ibsuun, hogganoota qabsoo kanaaf jedhanii ajjeefamanifis haqni akka argamu gaafataniiru.

title: Pope urges end to Amazon deforestation
english: Pope Francis has called for an immediate halt to the destruction of the Amazon rainforest, highlighting the dangers posed by illegal mining and logging. He emphasized that ecological preservation is deeply linked to social justice and the protection of local populations. The Pope urged for a balanced approach that secures the environment while safeguarding the rights of those residing in the region.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ፍራንሲስ በአማዞን የደን መጨፍጨፍና ሕገ-ወጥ የማዕድን ቁፋሮ በአካባቢው እና በነዋሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት በመፍጠሩ እንዲቆም አሳሰቡ። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ከማህበራዊ ፍትህ እና ከአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ መብት ጋር በቅርበት የተሳሰረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በመሆኑም የተፈጥሮ ሀብትን ከመጠበቅ ጎን ለጎን የአካባቢውን ህዝብ ደህንነት ማስጠበቅ እንደሚያስፈልግ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Papaa Firaansis bosonna Amaazonirratti mancaatiin fi qotannaan al-seeraa hawaasa fi naannicharratti balaa hamaa geessisaa waan jiruuf, hatattamaan akka dhaabbatu waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Eegumsi naannoo fi haqa hawaasummaa wal-qabatee kan deemuu qaban ta'uu ibsanii, jiraattonni naannichaa akka hin miidhamne taasisuun barbaachisaa ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Founder of Guadalajara cartel dies in hospital after decades in prison
english: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, a pioneer of the Mexican drug trade and founder of the Guadalajara cartel, has passed away in a hospital at age 80. He had been incarcerated since 1989 for his involvement in the 1985 murder of a U.S. drug enforcement agent. Known as the 'boss of bosses,' his criminal network laid the foundation for modern drug trafficking, fueling decades of violence and instability in the region.
amharic: የሜክሲኮው የጉዋዳላጃራ ካርቴል መስራች ሚጌል አንጀል ፌሊክስ ጋላርዶ በ80 ዓመታቸው በሆስፒታል ህክምና ላይ እያሉ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እ.ኤ.አ በ1985 አንድ የአሜሪካ የፀረ-አደንዛዥ እፅ ወኪልን በመግደላቸው ጥፋተኛ ተብለው ከ1989 ጀምሮ በእስር ቤት ቆይተዋል። 'የአለቆች አለቃ' በመባል የሚታወቀው ጋላርዶ፣ ዘመናዊውን የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር መዋቅር በመዘርጋት በክልሉ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት የዘለቀ የጦርነትና የሁከት መነሻ ሆነዋል።
oromo: Hundeesitoon garee yakka 'Guadalajara cartel' kan Meksikoo, Miigel Anjeel Feeliks Gaallaardoo, waggaa 80tti hospitaala keessatti lubbuun isaa darbeera. Bara 1989 irraa eegalee, ajjeechaa ergamaa gargaarsa farra qoricha sammuu Ameerikaa tokko kan bara 1985 raawwatamee ture irratti hirmaachuun isaa mirkanaa'ee hidhaa keessa ture. 'Mootii moototaa' jedhamee kan beekamu Gaallaardoon, gurmaa'ina daldala qoricha sammuu ammayyaa lafa kaayee, naannichatti waraanaafi jeequmsa waggoota dheeraaf itti fufeef sababa guddaa ta'eera.

title: After a nationwide ground stop, US faces aviation infrastructure questions
english: The US Federal Aviation Administration recently grounded all domestic flights for several hours due to a technical failure during an infrastructure upgrade, causing widespread travel chaos for millions. While President Trump has requested additional funding to modernize the system, Democratic lawmakers are questioning why previous investments have not been utilized effectively. Ongoing investigations are now focused on why a contractor’s efforts to replace outdated wiring led to such a significant disruption to national flight operations.

oromo: Hojii gaggeessaan balalii Ameerikaa rakkoo tekinikaa giddugaleessa haaraa irratti muudateen walqabatee balaliin hundinuu sa'aatii muraasaaf akka dhaabatu ajajeera, kunis imaltoota miliyoona hedduutti miidhaa geessiseera. Pirezidanti Traamp sirna kana ammayyeessuuf maallaqa dabalataa gaafatanis, miseensonni paartii mormituu maallaqni kanaan dura ramadame maaliif akka hin hojjetamne gaaffii kaasaa jiru. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, hojiin bu’uuraaleealee ammayyeessuu osoo jiru rakkoon kun maaliif akka uumame qorannoon gaggeeffamaa jira.

title: Czechs rally against gov’t threat to media independence
english: Thousands of protesters gathered in Prague to demonstrate against the Czech government's proposal to change how public media is funded. The current plan involves removing license fees and moving broadcast financing directly into the state budget. Opponents fear that this shift could jeopardize the independence of journalists and subject public media outlets to political pressure.

Karoorichi kaffaltii hayyamaa balleessee baajata miidiyaa kana kallattiin baajata mootummaa irraa akka ramadamu gaafata. Mormitoonni tarkaanfiin kun bilisummaa miidiyaa fi gaazexeessitootaa miidhee, miidiyaaleen mootummaa dhiibbaa siyaasaa jala akka galan sodaatu.

title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
english: President Volodymyr Zelensky has called on the US government and Elon Musk to remove speed restrictions on the Starshield satellite system, which is vital for Ukraine's defense. These technical limitations are currently hindering Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian missiles and drones, particularly as the country prepares for a difficult winter. Zelensky emphasized that fixing this connection issue is a moral imperative that is essential for protecting Ukrainian infrastructure and lives.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በዩክሬን የመከላከያ አቅም ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ያለውን የስታርሺልድ የሳተላይት ኢንተርኔት ፍጥነት ገደብ እንዲያነሱ አሜሪካን እና ኤሎን መስክን ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ የቴክኒክ ገደቦች ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ሚሳኤሎች እና ድሮኖች እንዳትከላከል እንቅፋት በመሆናቸው ለክረምት ወቅት ዝግጅት አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል። ፕሬዚዳንቱ የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶችን እና የዜጎችን ህይወት ለመታደግ ይህ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት መስተካከል እንዳለበት አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeeleniski mootummaan Amerikaa fi Elon Mask, tajaajila interneetii saatelayitii 'Starshield' irratti daangaa saffisaa kaa'ame akka kaasan gaafataniiru. Daangaan teeknikaa kun Yukreen xiyyaarota amantii malee fi misaa'eloota Raashiyaa akka hin ittifne waan taasiseef, qophii ji'a gannaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Pirezidaantichi bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi lubbuu lammiilee baraaruuf tajaajilli kun hatattamaan fooyya'uu akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Czechs rally against plan to switch funding of public media
english: Thousands of people recently gathered in Prague to protest a government plan to replace the public media license fee with state budget funding. Critics fear this change will threaten journalistic independence and allow politicians to exert control over broadcasters. While the government claims the move is a necessary update and will not impact editorial freedom, opponents argue it risks silencing objective reporting.
amharic: የቼክ ሪፐብሊክ መንግስት የህዝብ መገናኛ ብዙሃንን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ከነዋሪዎች ከሚሰበሰብ ክፍያ ወደ መንግስት በጀት ለመቀየር ያቀደውን እቅድ በመቃወም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በፕራግ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎች ይህ እርምጃ የመገናኛ ብዙሃንን ነፃነት እንደሚገድብ እና መንግስት በመገናኛ ብዙሃን ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንዲያሳድር እንደሚፈቅድ ይገልጻሉ። መንግስት በበኩሉ ይህ ማሻሻያ ለዘመናዊነት እንጂ የመገናኛ ብዙሃንን ነፃነት ለመንጠቅ አለመሆኑን ይከራከራል።
oromo: Namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman biyya Chekii magaalaa Praagitti walgahii guddaa gaggeessuun, mootummaan miidiyaalee uummataa kaffaltii dhaabbii irraa gara baajata mootummaatti jijjiiruuf karoorse mormaniiru. Mormitootni tarkaanfiin kun bilisummaa miidiyaalee kan miidhuu fi mootummaan miidiyaalee akka to'atu kan godhu ta'uu sodaatu. Mootummaan gama isaatiin, jijjiiramni kun haala ammayyaawaa ta'een raawwatamuu fi bilisummaa miidiyaalee irratti dhiibbaa kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsuun mormii kana haalu.

title: Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK urge Israel to allow aid into Gaza
english: Australia, Canada, Italy, and the UK have issued a joint call for Israel to immediately permit humanitarian aid to enter Gaza. These nations report that 150,000 tents and other essential relief items are currently being blocked at the border despite the severe humanitarian crisis caused by recent flooding. They emphasized that Israel must remove these obstacles to prevent further suffering as winter approaches and displaced families face a desperate need for shelter.
amharic: አውስትራሊያ፣ ካናዳ፣ ጣሊያን እና እንግሊዝ እስራኤል አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ወደ ጋዛ እንድታስገባ በጋራ ጠየቁ። እነዚህ ሀገራት በቅርቡ በተከሰተው የጎርፍ አደጋ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ለሚገኙ የጋዛ ነዋሪዎች የሚያስፈልጉ 150 ሺህ ድንኳኖች እና ሌሎች አስፈላጊ ቁሳቁሶች ድንበር ላይ ታግደው እንደሚገኙ ገልጸዋል። ክረምቱ ከመግባቱ በፊት እና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተፈናቃዮች ለከፋ ችግር ከመጋለጣቸው በፊት እስራኤል ይህንን እገዳ በአስቸኳይ እንድታነሳ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Awustiraaliyaan, Kaanaadaan, Xaaliyaaniifi UK waliin ta'uun Israa'el gargaarsi namoomaa hatattamaan gara Gaazaa akka seenu gaafataniiru. Biyyoonni kunneen akka ibsanitti, balaa lolaa dhiheenya kana mudateen booda, dunkaanni 150,000 ol ta'aniifi meeshaaleen barbaachisoon biroo daangaa irratti ugguramuun isaan dhorkamee jira. Qilleensi gannaas waan dhiyaateef, Israa'el ummanni bakka buqqa'e kun akka gargaaramuuf uggura kana hatattamaan akka kaastu gaafataniiru.

title: US Treasury chief calls for outsider to lead embattled tech firm Nvidia
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has urged Nvidia’s board to appoint an external candidate as their new CEO following the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang. Huang stepped down after reports surfaced regarding an extramarital affair with an individual suspected of links to Chinese intelligence. The company has also been given a 10-day deadline to prove it is following US export control regulations amid concerns over national security.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤት ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት የኤንቪዲያ መስራች ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከስልጣን መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ኩባንያው አዲሱን ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ከውስጥ ሳይሆን ከውጭ እንዲቀጥር ጠይቀዋል። ሁአንግ ከስልጣን የለቀቁት ከቻይና መረጃ ሰብሳቢዎች ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው ከተባሉ ሴት ጋር የፍቅር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው ከተገለጸ በኋላ ነው። በተጨማሪም ኤንቪዲያ የአሜሪካን የቴክኖሎጂ ኤክስፖርት ህጎች እያከበረ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ የ10 ቀናት የመጨረሻ ቀነ-ገደብ ተሰጥቶታል።
oromo: Ministeerri Qabeenyaa Ameerikaa Scott Bessent, hoggansaa fi hundeessaa dhaabbata Nvidia kan ta'an Jensen Huang gadhiisuu isaanii hordofee, hoggantoota haaraa dhaabbatichaa alaa akka ramadan gorsaniiru. Huang kan gadhiisan walitti dhufeenya miiraa kan qaban dubartii tokko waliin yoo ta'u, isheenis ogeessa basaastuu Chaayinaa ta'uu ishee shakkameera. Dhaabbatichi seera eksportii Ameerikaa kabajaa jiraachuu isaa guyyaa 10 keessatti akka mirkaneessus ajajameera.

title: Yemen’s Houthis unilaterally release 600 war detainees
english: The Houthi movement in Yemen has independently released 600 prisoners held during the ongoing civil war. This action is part of a larger amnesty program that has resulted in the freedom of over 2,600 detainees to date. According to the International Committee of the Red Cross, this specific release was carried out by the Houthis on their own rather than through formal exchange negotiations.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲዎች በሀገሪቱ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወቅት ታስረው የነበሩ 600 እስረኞችን በራሳቸው ፈቃድ ለቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ቡድኑ እስካሁን ድረስ በአጠቃላይ ከ2,600 በላይ እስረኞችን በምህረት መለቀቁን ያሳያል። ቀይ መስቀል እንዳስታወቀው፣ ይህ የእስረኞች መለቀቅ ከተለመደው ድርድር ውጪ በቡድኑ በራሱ ውሳኔ የተፈጸመ ነው።
oromo: Humni Houthii Yaman keessatti waraana sivilii yeroo dheeraaf turee keessatti namoota hidhaman 600 ta'an ofiin fedhii isaaniitiin gadi lakkiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun sagantaa dhiifamaa bal'aa isaan gaggeessaa jiran keessatti kan galu yoo ta'u, hanga ammaa namoota 2,600 oliif bilisummaa kenneera. Komishiniin Fannoo Diimaa Addunyaa akka ibsetti, gadi lakkifamuun namoota kanaa marii fi waljijjiirraa idilee alatti kan raawwatame dha.

title: Photos: Pope Leo visits Peru’s Amazon and Andean regions during 12-day tour
english: Pope Leo XIV recently concluded a 12-day tour of South America with final stops in Peru’s Andean and Amazonian regions. During his visit to Cusco and Pucallpa, he encouraged the preservation of Indigenous traditions and spoke out against the violence targeting environmental defenders. As the first Peruvian-born pope, he used his platform to call for justice and environmental protection amidst ongoing issues like deforestation and illegal mining.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በደቡብ አሜሪካ ያደረጉትን የ12 ቀናት ጉብኝት በፔሩ የአማዞን እና የአንዲያን አካባቢዎች በመጎብኘት አጠናቀዋል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት የአገሬው ተወላጆችን ባህል እንዲጠብቁ ያሳሰቡ ሲሆን፣ አካባቢን በመጠበቅ ላይ ለሚገኙ እና ለእነዚህ ጥረቶች ህይወታቸውን ላጡ ሰዎች ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን ጠይቀዋል። የመጀመሪያው የፔሩ ተወላጅ ሊቀ ጳጳስ እንደመሆናቸው፣ በክልሉ ውስጥ ስላለው ደን ጭፍጨፋ እና ህገ-ወጥ የማዕድን ቁፋሮ ችግሮች ላይም ትኩረት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Pappasii Liyo 14ffaan imala guyyaa 12f biyyoota Ameerikaa Kibbaa keessatti taasisaa turan, naannolee Peru kanneen akka Andean fi Amazon daawwachuun xumuran. Daawwannaa isaanii kanaan aadaa ummata naannichaa akka eeggatamu gorsuun, mirga dhaloota naannoo eeguuf falmatan irratti ajjeechaa fi miidhaa raawwatamu cimsanii balaaleeffataniiru. Pappasichi lammii Peru kan ta'an jalqabaa waan ta'aniif, dhimmoota mancaatii bosonaa fi qotannaa al-seeraa biyyattii keessatti mul'atu irratti xiyyeeffannoo kennuun haqni akka eegamu gaafataniiru.

title: Palestinians reclaim Gaza’s shores with a swim for hope
english: For the first time in over three years, the Gaza swimming federation organized a competition involving more than 200 participants. Families gathered on the coastline to cheer as the athletes raced, offering a rare moment of joy amidst the ongoing regional violence. This event provided a brief but meaningful escape from the daily hardships caused by the conflict.
amharic: ከሶስት ዓመታት በላይ በዘለቀው እረፍት፣ የጋዛ የዋና ፌዴሬሽን ከ200 በላይ ተሳታፊዎችን ያሳተፈ የዋና ውድድር አዘጋጅቷል። በክልሉ ካለው ተደጋጋሚ ግጭት መካከል ቤተሰቦች በባህር ዳርቻው ተሰብስበው ተወዳዳሪዎቹን በማበረታታት አጭር የደስታ ጊዜ አሳልፈዋል። ይህ ውድድር በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ለሚደርሰው ዕለታዊ መከራ አጭርና ትርጉም ያለው መዝናኛ ሆኗል።
oromo: waggaa sadii oliif addaan citee turee booda, federeeshiniin daakummaa Gaaza dorgommii daakummaa namoota 200 ol hirmaachise qopheesseera. Maatiin dorgommiicha ilaaluuf qarqara galaanatti walga'uun, walitti buiinsa naannicha keessa jiru gidduutti yeroo gammachuu xiqqoo argataniiru. Dorgommiin kun waraana kanaan walqabatee rakkoo guyyuu isaan mudatu keessaa boqonnaa gabaabaa fi hiika qabu kenneera.

title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
english: Iran recently launched two separate drone attacks against a US military base located in Bahrain. Bahraini defense systems successfully intercepted these attempts, preventing any significant damage or casualties. This escalation is part of a broader conflict between the two nations regarding control and security over the strategic Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: ኢራን በባህሬን በሚገኝ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ ሁለት ጊዜ ድሮን ጥቃት ሰንዝራለች። የባህሬን መከላከያ ኃይሎች ጥቃቶቹን መክተው በመጣላቸው ምንም ዓይነት ጉዳት አልደረሰም። ይህ ግጭት የተፈጠረው ሁለቱ ሀገራት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የባህር መተላለፊያ ቁጥጥር ላይ ባላቸው አለመግባባት ሳቢያ ነው።
oromo: Iiraan buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Bahrain keessatti argamu irratti guyyoota lama keessatti al lama haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) gaggeessiteetti. Humnoonni ittisaa Bahrain haleellaa kana hatattamaan waan fashaleessaniif miidhaan tokkollee hin geenye. Walitti bu’insi kun kan uumame biyyoonni lameen kun to’annoo daandii galaana Hormuz irratti walii galuu waan hin dandeenyeefi.

title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
english: A South Korean man who achieved the top score on a professional tax accounting exam has confessed to using a hidden camera and artificial intelligence to cheat. He admitted to photographing test questions to receive answers via his smartphone, which led to widespread outrage as government officials now vow to increase exam security. Consequently, the individual will lose his certification and face a five-year ban from taking the exam, while authorities investigate how to prevent similar incidents in the future.
amharic: በደቡብ ኮሪያ ከፍተኛውን የግብር የሂሳብ አያያዝ ፈተና ውጤት ያስመዘገበ አንድ ግለሰብ፣ የተደበቀ ካሜራ እና አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ በመጠቀም እንዳታለለ አምኗል። ግለሰቡ የፈተና ጥያቄዎችን በካሜራ ቀርጾ በስልኩ አማካኝነት መልሶችን እንደተቀበለ የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞን አስነሳ። በመሆኑም የተሰጠው ውጤት ተሰርዞ ለቀጣይ አምስት ዓመታት ፈተናውን እንዳይወስድ የተከለከለ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትም ለወደፊቱ ተመሳሳይ ማጭበርበሮችን ለመከላከል ጥብቅ እርምጃዎችን እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Namni Kooriyaa Kibbaa keessatti qormaata herrega gibiraa irratti qabxii olaanaa galmeessise tokko, kaameeraa dhokataa fi teeknoolojii AI fayyadamuudhaan akka gowwoomse amaneera. Gaaffii qormaataa kaameeraadhaan fudhatee deebii isaa bilbila harkaa isaa irratti akka argate erga amanee booda, mootummaan gara fuulduraatti qormaata irratti to'annoo cimaa akka godhu ibseera. Bu'aan isaa akka haqamuufi waggaa shanf qormaata kana akka hin fudhanne kan dhorkame yoo ta'u, mootummaan gocha akkanaa kana ittisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu beeksiseera.

title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
english: Alice Huang, a suspected Chinese spy linked to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, departed her executive role at the Singaporean firm Megaspeed in 2025. This development follows Jensen Huang's resignation amid a scandal involving personal affairs and allegations that Megaspeed may have bypassed US export restrictions to supply restricted AI chips to China. Megaspeed is currently conducting an internal investigation, while US officials are scrutinizing the oversight of chip exports following these security concerns.
amharic: ከኤንቪዲያ የቀድሞ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ ጋር ግንኙነት አላት የተባለችውና የቻይና ሰላይ ናት ተብላ የምትጠረጠረው አሊስ ሁዋንግ በ2025 ከሲንጋፖሩ ሜጋስፒድ ኩባንያ መልቀቋ ተነግሯል። ይህ የሆነው የኩባንያው የቀድሞ አለቃ በግል ጉዳዮችና ከፍተኛ የቴክኖሎጂ ቺፖችን ለቻይና በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ አሳልፈዋል በሚል ቅሌት ስልጣናቸውን ከለቀቁ በኋላ ነው። ሜጋስፒድ የውስጥ ምርመራ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናትም የቺፕ ኤክስፖርት ቁጥጥር ስርዓት ላይ ጥያቄዎችን እያነሱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Alis Huwaang, namni akka humni basaasaa Chaayinaatti shakkamtee fi hogganaa duraanii Nvidia, Jeensen Huwaang wajjin walitti dhufeenya qabdu jedhamte, bara 2025 dhaabbata Singapoori Meegaaspdiin gadi lteetti. Rakkoon kun kan dhufe erga Jeensen Huwaang dhimma dhuunfaa fi teeknooloojiiwwan Nvidia gara Chaayinaatti seeraan ala ergamanirratti himatamee booda. Meegaaspdiin amma qorannoo keessaa gaggeessaa jiru yoo ta'u, mootummaan Ameerikaas dhimma raabsaa teeknooloojii kanarratti qorannoo cimaa jalqabeera.

title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
english: Israeli forces have killed Samir Abu Younis, a high-ranking Hamas commander who was involved in organizing the October 7, 2023, attacks. The strike occurred at a camp for displaced people in Al-Mawasi, Gaza, after the military identified him as a key figure working to rebuild Hamas operations. While Israel stated it attempted to reduce civilian harm, Hamas condemned the attack as a cowardly assassination.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት በማቀናበር የተሳተፈውን ከፍተኛ የሃማስ አዛዥ ሳሚር አቡ ዩኒስን በጋዛ የአየር ጥቃት መግደሉን አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው በጋዛ አል-ማዋሲ በተባለ መጠለያ ካምፕ ውስጥ ሲሆን እስራኤል አዛዡ የሃማስን አቅም ለማደስ እየሰራ ነበር ብላለች። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን ከመፈጸሟ በፊት የሲቪሎችን ጉዳት ለመቀነስ ጥረት ማድረጓን የገለጸች ሲሆን ሃማስ ግን ድርጊቱን ፈሪሃዊ ግድያ በማለት አውግዞታል።
oromo: Humnootiin Israa'el ajaja olaanaa garee Hamaas kan ta'an Saamir Abuu Yuunis, weerara Onkoloolessa 7, 2023 qindeesuuf gahee qaban ajjeesuu isaanii ibsan. Ajjeefama kanatti kanneen dhibbetti argaman kaampii Gaza keessatti erga isaan qorannoon adda baafaman booda haleellaa qilleensaan kan raawwatame dha. Israa'el ajajaan kun humna Hamaas deebisanii ijaaruuf hojjetaa akka ture kan ibsite yoo ta'u, miidhaa siviloota hambisuuf yaalii gochuu ishee himte; gama biraatiin Hamaas ajjeechaa kana gocha suukanneessaa jechuun balaaleffateera.

title: Nearly 1,500 migrants reach Spain’s Canary Islands in one day
english: Nearly 1,500 migrants arrived at Spain’s Canary Islands in a single day, marking the highest volume of arrivals in one day since 2020. The individuals traveled in 14 separate boats, mostly originating from Senegal, The Gambia, and Guinea. Rescue services were mobilized to assist those reaching the islands.
amharic: በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ ወደ ስፔን የካናሪ ደሴቶች ወደ 1,500 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች የገቡ ሲሆን ይህም ከ2020 ወዲህ የታየ ከፍተኛው ቁጥር ነው። እነዚህ ሰዎች በ14 ጀልባዎች ተጉዘው የደረሱ ሲሆን አብዛኞቹ የመጡት ከሴኔጋል፣ ከጋምቢያ እና ከጊኒ ነው። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ደሴቶቹ ላይ የደረሱትን ስደተኞች ለመርዳት ተንቀሳቅሰዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa tokkotti godaantonni 1,500 ta’an gara kutaalee gannaa Ispeen, Kanari Aayilandi ga’an, kunis bara 2020 as lakkoofsa guyyaa tokkotti hanga kana ga’e guddaa dha. Namoonni kunneen doonii 14 gargar ta’aniin kan imalan yoo ta’u, hedduun isaanii biyyoota Senegaal, Gaambiyaa fi Giinii irraa dhufan. Tajaajilli gargaarsa namoomaa namoota gara biyyattii ga’an kana gargaaruuf bobba’eera.

title: Morocco becomes first Arab nation in FIFA’s top five men’s rankings
english: Morocco has made history as the first Arab nation to break into the top five of FIFA’s men's football rankings. The team achieved this milestone after rising two spots following impressive performances in recent matches. This accomplishment adds to their record-breaking success, which includes consecutive World Cup quarterfinal appearances and a strong showing in current Africa Cup of Nations qualifying.
amharic: ሞሮኮ በፊፋ የወንዶች እግር ኳስ ደረጃ አሰጣጥ በአምስቱ ምርጥ ሀገራት ውስጥ በመግባት የመጀመሪያዋ የአረብ ሀገር በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርታለች። ቡድኑ ይህንን ስኬት ያገኘው በቅርብ ጊዜ ባሳየው ጥሩ ብቃት ደረጃውን በሁለት ደረጃዎች በማሻሻል ነው። ይህ ስኬት በተከታታይ የዓለም ዋንጫ ሩብ ፍጻሜ መድረሷን እና በአፍሪካ ዋንጫ ማጣሪያ እያሳየች ያለውን ጠንካራ እንቅስቃሴ ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Morookoon biyya Arabaa jalqabaa taatee tarree sadarkaa FIFA keessatti gosoota shanan ol aanaa keessatti argamuun seenaa hojjetteetti. Gareen kun sadarkaa isaa sadarkaa torbaffaa irraa gara shanaffaatti kan ol guddiifate taphoota isaanii darban irratti qophii gaarii taasisuun isaaniitiin. Milkaa'inni kun injifannoo garoota kubbaa miillaa biyyattii kanneen akka waancaa addunyaa fi qulqulleeffannaa waancaa Afrikaarratti argatan kan gargaaru dha.

title: Yemeni government forces redeploy from Bab al-Mandeb to defend Aden
english: Yemeni government-aligned forces are withdrawing from the Bab al-Mandeb region to prioritize the defense of Aden. This strategic shift aims to protect the interim capital from potential Houthi advances while redirecting resources to help break the ongoing siege in Taiz. The move marks a setback for recent government efforts to reclaim western coastal territories held by Houthi fighters.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ደጋፊ ኃይሎች አደን ከተማን ለመከላከል ሲሉ ከባብ አል-ማንደብ አካባቢ እየወጡ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ስልታዊ እርምጃ ዋና ከተማዋን ከሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት ለመጠበቅ እና የታኢዝን ከበባ ለመስበር ያለመ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ መንግስት በቅርቡ በምዕራብ የባህር ዳርቻ ያደረገውን ጥቃት በማስተጓጎል በጦርነቱ ላይ አዲስ ለውጥ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnooni mootummaa Yaman magaalaa Aden eeguuf jechuun naannoo Bab al-Mandeb irraa gadi lakkisanii bahuuf murteessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun magaalaa Aden weerara Huthirraa ittisuuf fi magaalaa Ta’izitti marfamee jiru furuuf kan gargaaruudha. Murtoon kun humnooni mootummaa bakkeewwan guddina qaban to’achuuf godhaniin turan akka daangeffamu taasisa.

title: The hidden costs of the US AI boom
english: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence in the United States is leading to public opposition against the construction of new data centers. Local residents are increasingly worried about the environmental impact, specifically regarding excessive noise, pollution, and the massive electricity requirements of these facilities. This tension highlights the growing conflict between the demand for advanced technology and the concerns of the communities hosting the necessary infrastructure.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ውስጥ ያለው ፈጣን የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) እድገት አዳዲስ የመረጃ ማዕከላት ግንባታ ላይ ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞ እያስነሳ ነው። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች በእነዚህ ተቋማት የሚፈጠር ከፍተኛ የድምፅ ብክለት፣ የአየር መበከል እና ግዙፍ የኤሌክትሪክ ፍጆታ ስጋት እያደረባቸው ይገኛል። ይህ ሁኔታ ለዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂ ያለው ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት እና መሰረተ ልማቱ በሚገነባባቸው አካባቢዎች የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ስጋት መካከል ያለውን መቃቃር ያሳያል።
oromo: Guddina saffisaa 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) jedhamuun biyya Ameerikaatti mul'achaa jiru, ijaarsa bakkeewwan odeeffannoo (data centers) haaraa irratti mormii uummataa kaasuu jalqabeera. Jiraattonni naannichaa dhageettii sagalee ol'aanaa, faalama qilleensaa fi akkaataa humna ibsaa guddaa barbaadan kanaaf yaaddoo qabu. Kuni immoo walitti dhufeenya guddina teeknoolojii fi yaaddoo uummata naannoo buufataalee kanaa jidduu jiru ifa godha.

title: Somalia: We would not have recovered without the international community
english: Somali official Ali Mohamed Omar credits international support for the country's progress since its government collapsed three decades ago. While the nation has begun managing its own affairs after a long-running UN mission ended, it still faces significant hurdles including the al-Shabab insurgency and reduced funding for regional peacekeepers. The government remains focused on stabilizing the country and hopes to maintain foreign financial aid to build a stronger state.
amharic: የሶማሊያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አሊ መሐመድ ኦማር፣ አገሪቱ ከሠላሳ ዓመታት በፊት ከወደቀችበት ጊዜ አንስቶ ላስመዘገበችው መሻሻል ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ያደረገው ድጋፍ ወሳኝ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሶማሊያ የራሷን ጉዳይ በራሷ ለመምራት እየጣረች ቢሆንም፣ በአል-ሸባብ ቡድን የሚደርሰው ጥቃት እና ለሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይሎች የሚደረገው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ መቀነስ ከፍተኛ ፈተና ሆኖባቸዋል። መንግስት መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን እየሰራ ሲሆን፣ ጠንካራ አገር ለመገንባት ዓለም አቀፍ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልገው አስታውቋል።
oromo: Hogganaan mootummaa Somaaliyaa Alii Mohaammad Oomar, biyyattiin waggoota soddoma darban keessa gama nagaa fi tasgabbii irra gahuuf deeggarsa hawaasa idil-addunyaa akka qabdu ibsaniiru. Somaaliyaan adeemsa of danda'uuf godhamaa jiru keessa kan jirtu ta'us, garee al-Shabaab irraa miidhaa jiru fi deeggarsa qarshii waraana naga eegduuf laatamu irratti hir'inni mul'achuu isaatiin walqabatee rakkoon jira. Mootummaan biyyattii tasgabbeessuuf hojjechaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, gama dinagdeetiin deeggarsa biyyoota alaa akka barbaadu beeksiseera.

title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
english: A fifth Canadian soldier has passed away from injuries sustained during a massive grass fire at CFB Wainwright last month. The blaze was triggered by a grenade launcher during a training exercise and spread rapidly due to high winds, causing dozens of casualties. Officials confirm that 24 soldiers remain hospitalized as investigations into the incident continue.

oromo: Ji'a darbe buufata waraanaa Wainwright keessatti balaa ibidda bosonaa mudateen walqabatee loltuun keenya shanaffaan lubbuun darbeera. Ibidni kun kan ka'e leenjii waraanaa irratti rukuttaa rookeettii booda yoo ta'u, qilleensa cimaan bal'achuu isaa hordofee loltoota hedduu miidheera. Amma ammaatti loltoonni 24 hospitaala keessatti wal'aanamaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, qorannoon balaa kanaas itti fufee jira.

title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
english: A Jordanian court has sentenced three men to death for a deadly shooting at a Greek Orthodox church last month that left nine people dead and dozens injured. The attackers, who were captured after a shootout with security forces, were convicted of terrorism-related charges, including conspiracy and weapon possession. King Abdullah II condemned the violence, and Jordan has since launched retaliatory military actions against militant groups in neighboring Syria.

oromo: Mana murtii Yordaanos keessatti namoonni sadii ji’a darbe mana sagadaa Ortodoksii Giriikii keessatti namoota sagal ajjeesuufi namoota hedduu miidhuun himataman du’aan adabaman. Mootii Abdullaah II gocha kana cimsanii balaaleffataniiru; Yordaanosis tarkaanfii kanaaf deebii kennuuf jecha gareewwan shororkeessaa biyya ollaa Siiriyaa keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa waraanaa raawwateera.

title: Police confront protesters in clashes across France and Germany
english: Massive demonstrations occurred across cities in France and Germany as people rallied against the rising cost of living, austerity measures, and school funding issues. Security forces responded to the large crowds by using water cannons and tear gas to break up the protests. Tens of thousands of participants joined these events to voice their frustration with current economic policies.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ እና በጀርመን ከተሞች እየጨመረ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት፣ የቁጠባ እርምጃዎችን እና የትምህርት በጀት እጥረትን በመቃወም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ሰልፈኞቹን ለመበተን የውኃ መርጫ እና አስለቃሽ ጭስ ተጠቅመዋል። በብዛት የተሰባሰቡት ተቃዋሚዎች በመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ በሰልፉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Faranseeyyii fi Jarmanii keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman gatii jireenyaa dabaluu, tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fi dhimma baajata barnootaa mormuun hiriira bahaniiru. title: Give Donbas, take NATO seat: Could new US pitch work for Ukraine, Russia?
english: The U.S. government has proposed a potential peace deal where Ukraine could gain NATO membership in exchange for ceding control of the Donbas region to Russia. This suggestion was conveyed to President Zelenskyy by American negotiators following recent discussions with both Ukrainian and Russian leadership. While this move aims to resolve the long-standing conflict, it remains controversial as both nations have historically rejected these specific territorial and alliance-related compromises.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ዩክሬን የዶንባስን ክልል ለሩሲያ በመልቀቅ በምትኩ የኔቶ አባል መሆን የምትችልበትን የሰላም አማራጭ አቅርቧል። ይህ ሀሳብ በአሜሪካ ድርድር አቅራቢዎች በኩል ለፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ የደረሰ ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ሲልም ከሩሲያ መሪዎች ጋር ውይይት ተደርጎበታል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ እቅድ ጦርነቱን ለማቆም ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ ሁለቱም ሀገራት በቀድሞ አቋማቸው መሰረት የየራሳቸውን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች በመያዛቸው ጉዳዩ አወዛጋቢ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa, Yukreen naannoo Donbaas gadi dhiistee yoo argatte miseensa NATO ta'uu akka dandeessu yaada nageenyaa dhiyeesseera. Yaada kana kan dhiyeessan gurguddoo dhimma nageenyaa kan Ameerikaa yoo ta'u, kanaan dura prezidaant Zelenskii fi mootummaa Roosiyaa waliin mari'ataniiru. Yaadni kun waraana dhaabuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, biyyootni lamaanuu kanaan dura lafaafi bu'uura siyaasaa isaanii irratti walii galuun waan ulfaateef, ammaas fudhatama argachuun isaa shakkii keessa jira.

title: India’s Under-19 Asia Cup win over Pakistan marred by post-match aggression
english: India secured a dramatic one-wicket victory over Pakistan in the Under-19 Asia Cup final in Oman after a remarkable late-game comeback. Despite the impressive win, the celebration was tarnished by aggressive behavior from the Indian players toward their Pakistani counterparts. Former cricketers and fans have criticized these unsportsmanlike actions, emphasizing the importance of maintaining respect and composure regardless of the match outcome.
amharic: ሕንድ በኦማን በተካሄደው ከ19 ዓመት በታች የእስያ ዋንጫ ፍጻሜ፣ ፓኪስታንን በአስደናቂ ሁኔታ በአንድ ዊኬት በማሸነፍ ዋንጫውን ወስዳለች። ነገር ግን የድል በዓሉ በሕንድ ተጫዋቾች በፓኪስታን ተጫዋቾች ላይ ባሳዩት እጅግ አፀያፊ እና ጨዋነት የጎደለው ድርጊት ጥላ አርፎበታል። የቀድሞ የክሪኬት ተጫዋቾችና ደጋፊዎች ይህንን ድርጊት አውግዘው፣ በውጤቱ ላይ ሳይወሰኑ ስፖርታዊ ጨዋነትንና አክብሮትን ማስቀደም እንደሚገባ አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Indiyaan tapha xumuraa waancaa Eshiyaa kan umrii waggaa 19 gadii biyya Omaaniitti gaggeeffame irratti Paakistaaniin goolii tokkoon injifatteetti. Injifannoon kun kan nama ajaa'ibu ta'us, taphattoonni Indiyaa tapha booda gocha amala gaarii hin taane fi jeequmsa uuman mormii guddaa hordofsiiseera. Taphattoonni durii fi hordoftoonni ispoortii gocha kana balaaleffachuun, injifannoo boodas ta'e kufaatii booda kabajaa fi tasgabbii qabaachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Spain football coach denies racism ahead of England match
english: Spain's football coach, Luis de la Fuente, has rejected claims that racism is a prevalent issue within his country. This statement follows comments from England manager Thomas Tuchel, who indicated he would prepare his team regarding anti-racism procedures before their Nations League game. The exchange has sparked a renewed public conversation regarding the state of racial discrimination in Spanish sports.

Yaanni kun kan dhufe leenjisaan garee Ingiliz Tomas Tuchel tapha 'Nations League' dura waa'ee ittisa jibba sanyummaa ilaalchisee taphattoota isaanii akka gorsan erga himanii booda. Wal- jijjiirraan yaadaa kunis, ispoortii Ispeen keessatti rakkoo jibba sanyummaa irratti mariin akka haaromfamu godheera.

title: Polls open in Cape Verde in race with first female presidential candidate
english: Voters in Cape Verde are heading to the polls to decide between incumbent President Jose Maria Neves and five challengers, including the country's first female presidential candidate, Joana Rosa. The election is focused on addressing the nation's significant emigration challenges driven by a lack of local job opportunities. While Neves is considered the favorite to secure a second term, the vote is a notable milestone in the archipelago's history of political stability.

oromo: Filattoon biyya Keeyp Veerdee kan gaggeeffamaa jiru yoo ta'u, pirezidantii ammaa Josee Maariyaa Neevesii fi dorgomtoota shan biroo, kanneen keessaa dubartii pirezidantummaaf dorgomtuu jalqabaa kan ta'an Jo'aanaa Roosaa dabalatee dorgomaa jiru. Filattoon kun rakkoo hojii dhabdummaa fi godaansa dargaggootaa biyyattii mudate irratti xiyyeeffata. title: Jordan condemns Iranian drone strike on Bahrain
english: Jordan has officially denounced Iran for launching drone strikes against Bahrain, labeling the action a serious violation of international law. The Jordanian government expressed concern that these aggressive acts threaten the stability and sovereignty of their regional ally. This condemnation highlights growing tensions in the Middle East as nations remain worried about the potential for wider regional conflict.
amharic: ዮርዳኖስ ኢራን በባህሬን ላይ የፈፀመችውን የድሮን ጥቃት በአስشدድ አውግዛለች። የዮርዳኖስ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ይህ ድርጊት የአለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ እና የባህሬንን ሉዓላዊነት አደጋ ላይ የሚጥል አደገኛ ቅስቀሳ መሆኑን ገልጿል። በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣው ውጥረት ሰላምን ስጋት ውስጥ እንደጣለውም ተጠቁሟል።

title: IRGC says Bahrain drone strike responded to ‘US aggression’ in southern Iran
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) recently conducted a drone strike against a US helicopter base in Bahrain. This military action was described by Iran as a retaliatory measure following an American attack on a telecommunications tower located in southern Iran. Officials from the IRGC warned that any further aggression from the United States will be met with firm and strategic responses.
amharic: የኢራኑ እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘብ (IRGC) በባህሬን በሚገኝ የአሜሪካ ሄሊኮፕተር ጣቢያ ላይ የድሮን ጥቃት ማድረሱን አስታውቋል። ይህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ በደቡብ ኢራን ውስጥ በሚገኝ የቴሌኮሙኒኬሽን ግንብ ላይ በአሜሪካ ለተፈጸመው ጥቃት የአጸፋ ምላሽ መሆኑን ኢራን ገልጻለች። የአብዮታዊ ዘቡ ባለስልጣናት ከአሜሪካ የሚሰነዘር ማንኛውም ጥቃት ጠንካራ እና ስልታዊ ምላሽ እንደሚከተለው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Eegumsa Killa'aa Islaamaa (IRGC) kan Iiraan, buufata helikoptara Ameerikaa kan Bahrain keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa xiyyaara maleeyyuu (drone) raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun haleellaa Ameerikaan gamoo quunnamtii Iiraan kibbaatti argamu irratti raawwatteef deebii kan kenname ta'uu mootummaan Iiraan beeksiseera. Hojjettoonni IRGC, weerarri kamiyyuu kan Ameerikaa irraa dhufu deebii cimaa fi karooraan kan laatamu ta'uu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: ‘Looking away was never a choice for me’: How Hollywood’s love affair with Israel turned sour
english: Hollywood's long-standing support for Israel is shifting as many influential actors and filmmakers publicly condemn the violence in Gaza. Over 5,500 industry professionals have signed a pledge to avoid collaborating with Israeli institutions linked to the conflict, drawing inspiration from historical boycotts against apartheid South Africa. By using award ceremonies and professional contracts to express their stance, these artists are increasingly prioritizing human rights over industry normalization.
amharic: የሆሊውድ የረጅም ጊዜ የእስራኤል ድጋፍ እየተቀየረ ሲሆን ብዙ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪ ተዋናዮች እና የፊልም ሰሪዎች በጋዛ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን ጥቃት በይፋ በመቃወም ላይ ናቸው። ከ5,500 በላይ የኢንዱስትሪው ባለሙያዎች ከግጭቱ ጋር ግንኙነት ካላቸው የእስራኤል ተቋማት ጋር ላለመስራት ቃል ገብተዋል። እነዚህ አርቲስቶች በሽልማት ስነ-ስርዓቶች እና በስራ ውላቸው አማካኝነት አቋማቸውን በመግለጽ፣ ከኢንዱስትሪው የተለመደ አሰራር ይልቅ ለሰብአዊ መብቶች ቅድሚያ እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Deeggarsi Hollywood yeroo dheeraaf Israa'eliif qabu jijjiiramuudhaan, gocha waraana Gaza keessatti raawwatamu cimsanii mormaa jiru. Ogganoonni fi artistoonni filmii 5,500 ol ta'an dhaabbilee Israa'el waraana kana keessatti hirmaatan waliin hojjechuu dhiisuuf waadaa galaniiru. Artistoonni kunneen sirna badhaasaa fi waliigaltee hojii isaanii fayyadamudhaan, dantaa industrii irra mirga namoomaaf dursaa akka kennan ifa godhaniiru.

title: Morning update
english: The Middle East is facing heightened regional tensions involving drone and missile attacks between Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Iranian-backed forces. In other developments, a senior Hamas commander was killed in an Israeli strike, and violence persists in the West Bank and Syria. Meanwhile, the U.S. is reportedly reconsidering potential military action against Iran based on intelligence about its large missile stockpile.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ በባህሬን እና በኢራን በሚደገፉ ኃይሎች መካከል የሚካሄድ ድሮን እና ሚሳይል ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የፀጥታ ውጥረት ተባብሷል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ከፍተኛ የሃማስ አዛዥ በእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት የተገደሉ ሲሆን፣ በዌስት ባንክ እና በሶሪያም ግጭቶች ቀጥለዋል። አሜሪካ በበኩሏ ስለ ኢራን ሰፊ የሚሳይል ክምችት ባላት መረጃ መሰረት በኢራን ላይ ልትወስድ ያቀደችውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እየገመገመች ነው።
oromo: Naannawa Baha Giddugaleessatti weerara xiyyaara malee fi misayilii Sa'udii Arabiyaa, Baahireen fi humnoota Iraaniin deggeraman gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee rakkoon nageenyaa cimaa jira. Gama biraatiin, ajajaan olaanaa dhaabbata Hamaas weerara qilleensaatiin kan ajjeefaman yoo ta'u, weerarri naannawa Lixa Baankii fi Sooriyaa keessattis itti fufeera. Itoophiyaan akkasumas, Ameerikaan dandeettii misayilii Iraan irratti odeeffannoo qabduun walqabatee tarkaanfii waraanaa irratti fudhachuuf karoorfatte ture irra deebitee madaalaa jirti.

title: Bahraini defence forces say several Iranian aerial attacks intercepted
english: The Bahraini military successfully blocked a series of aerial attacks launched by Iran on Sunday. Officials condemned these actions as part of a recurring hostile strategy against the kingdom. In response, the country's armed forces have heightened their defensive alert to ensure national security.
amharic: የባህሬን መከላከያ ሰራዊት እሁድ ዕለት ኢራን የሰነዘረችባቸውን ተከታታይ የአየር ላይ ጥቃቶች ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን ጥቃቶች በባህሬን ላይ የሚፈጸሙ የጥላቻ ድርጊቶች አካል እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል። የሀገሪቱ የጦር ኃይሎች የሀገሪቱን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ዝግጁነታቸውን በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ማሳደጋቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Baahireyn Dilbata darbe haleellaa qilleensa irraa Iran irraa isaanirratti gaggeeffame akka fashaleesse beeksiseera. Hoggantoonni biyyattii haleellaa kana sochii diinummaa sirnaawaa ta'e jechuun balaaleffataniiru. Haala kanaan, waltajjii ittisaa biyyattii nageenya isaanii eeguuf jecha sadarkaa eegumsa isaanii ol aantumatti ol guddisaniiru.

title: Pope Leo speaks of community 'suffering' on visit to remote Andes town
english: Pope Leo XIV recently visited the remote Andean village of Santa Cruz de Succhabamba, a place where he served as a bishop for several years. During an outdoor mass, he addressed the hardships faced by the local community, specifically highlighting poverty, the struggle of migration, and declining populations. The Pope expressed his emotional connection to the area and encouraged the residents to remain hopeful despite the significant socioeconomic challenges facing the region.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በቅርቡ በፔሩ ወደሚገኘው የሳንታ ክሩዝ ደ ሱቻባምባ ገጠራማ መንደር ተጉዘዋል። ጳጳሱ ቀደም ሲል ለብዙ ዓመታት በቆዩበት በዚህ ስፍራ ባደረጉት ንግግር፣ በድህነት፣ በስደት እና በሕዝብ ቁጥር መቀነስ ምክንያት ለሚሰቃዩት የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ያላቸውን አጋርነት ገልጸዋል። በችግሮች ውስጥም ቢሆን ተስፋ እንዳይቆርጡ ነዋሪዎቹን አበረታተዋል።
oromo: Pappasii Liyo 14ffaan yeroo dhihoo kana biyya Peru keessatti gara baadiyaa Santa Kruuz de Suuchaabaambaa deemanii jiru. Bakka kanaan dura waggoota hedduuf biyya bulchaa turan sanatti, haasawaa godhaniin hiyyummaa, godaansaa fi hir'ina baay'ina ummataa rakkoolee hawaasichaa ta'anirratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Pappasichi rakkoolee jiran hunda keessattuu ummatni abdii akka hin kunne isaan jajjabeessaniiru.

title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation
english: A federal judge has issued a temporary order preventing the Trump administration from closing the historic East Potomac Golf Links in Washington DC for renovations. The judge ruled that the government violated federal laws and failed to justify the closure of this public parkland. This decision halts the proposed improvements until at least November 28th, keeping the golf course open while legal challenges continue.
amharic: የፌዴራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የሚገኘውን ታሪካዊ የጎልፍ ሜዳ ለማደስ ብሎ የዘጋውን እገዳ ለጊዜው አግደዋል። ዳኛዋ መንግሥት የፌዴራል ሕጎችን እንደጣሰ እና የሕዝብ ፓርኩን ለመዝጋት የቀረበው ምክንያት በቂ እንዳልሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ እስከ ህዳር 28 ድረስ የጎልፍ ሜዳው እንዲከፈት የሚያደርግ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በሕግ አግባብ እስኪጣራ ድረስ ሥራው እንዲቆም አዟል።
oromo: Abbaan murtiin federalaa tokko bulchiinsi Trump dirree golfii seena-qabeessa Washington DC jiru akka hin cufne ajaja yeroo dabarsaniiru. Abbaan murtichaa mootummaan seera federalaa cabsuusaa fi iddoo kana cufuuf sababni dhiyeesse gahaa akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Murteen kun hanga guyyaa 28 Sadaasaatti hojii haaromsaa kan dhaabu yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun seeraan hanga ilaalamuutti dirreen golfichaa akka banamee turu godha.

title: Italian artist reimagines Madonna paintings to expose Gaza’s pain
english: Italian artist Eduardo Castaldo has created an installation called 'Holy Mothers of Gaza' in a Naples chapel. The artwork features traditional Madonna paintings that conceal real photographs of Gaza taken by journalist Omar El Qattaa beneath their surface. This project aims to use classical religious imagery to highlight the suffering currently experienced by people in Gaza.
amharic: ጣሊያናዊው አርቲስት ኤድዋርዶ ካስታዶ በኔፕልስ በሚገኝ ቤተ-ክርስቲያን ውስጥ 'የጋዛ ቅዱሳን እናቶች' የተሰኘ አዲስ የጥበብ ስራ አቅርቧል። የጥበብ ስራው ባህላዊ የድንግል ማርያም ምስሎችን በመጠቀም፣ ከስራቸው ደግሞ በጋዜጠኛ ኦማር ኤል ቀታ የተነሱ የጋዛ እውነተኛ ፎቶግራፎችን ይዟል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት የሃይማኖታዊ ጥበብ ስራዎችን በመጠቀም በጋዛ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሰዎችን ስቃይ ለዓለም ለማሳየት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Artistii biyya Xaaliyaanii Edoardo Castaldo jedhamu, mana sagadaa Nepples keessatti 'Haadholii Qulqulluu Gaza' jedhuun hojii ogummaa tokko agarsiiseera. Hojiin kun, fakkiiwwan Maariyaam kan aadaa ta'an kan gubbaa isaanii irraa saaqaman yoo ta'u, jala isaa immoo suuraawwan dhugaa kan gaazexeessaa Omaar El Qattaa Gaza keessatti kaase agarsiisa. Kaayyoon hojii kanaa, fakkiiwwan amantii fayyadamuun miidhaa fi gidiraa yeroo ammaa Gaza keessatti namoota irra gahaa jiru ifa baasudha.

title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts two missiles, two drones in Riyadh
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted two ballistic missiles and two drones aimed at Riyadh by Houthi rebels. This incident follows a period of heightened military conflict across Yemen, particularly in the Marib and al-Jawf regions. Both sides reported significant recent tactical operations and casualties as the regional fighting intensifies.
amharic: በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በሁቲ አማፂያን ወደ ሪያድ የተተኮሱ ሁለት ባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን እና ሁለት ድሮኖችን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት በየመን በተለይም በማሪብ እና በአል-ጃውፍ አካባቢዎች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው። ሁለቱም ወገኖች በቅርቡ ባደረጓቸው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii durfamu, xiyyara maleeyyii fi boombiiwwan mookteetii Huutonni gara Riyaaditti ergaman hunda qilleensa irratti barbadeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Kunis, waraanni Yaman keessatti, keessattuu naannoo Maariibii fi Al-Jaawfitti hammaachuu isaa agarsiisa. Gammachuu waraana kanaatiin walqabatee, giddutti miidhaan namaa fi meeshaalee irra ga’uun isaas gabaasameera.

title: Iraq PM sacks nine officials over oil smuggling in pro-Iran stronghold
english: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has fired nine senior security and oil officials following an investigation into massive oil smuggling operations in the Jurf al-Nasr region. The area, controlled by the Iran-backed group Kataib Hezbollah, had been illegally siphoning oil from strategic pipelines through hidden refineries. The government is now taking legal action against those involved and asserting control over areas that previously operated beyond state authority.
amharic: የኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አሊ አል-ዛኢዲ በጁርፍ አል-ናስር አካባቢ በተደረገ የነዳጅ ኮንትሮባንድ ምርመራ ዘጠኝ ከፍተኛ የደህንነት እና የነዳጅ ዘርፍ ባለስልጣናትን ከስራ አሰናብተዋል። በኢራን በሚደገፈው ካታኢብ ሄዝቦላህ ቁጥጥር ስር በሚገኘው አካባቢ፣ ህገ-ወጥ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎችን በመጠቀም ከስትራቴጂካዊ የነዳጅ መስመሮች ነዳጅ ይሰረቅ ነበር። መንግስት በተሳታፊዎች ላይ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እየወሰደ ሲሆን ከዚህ በፊት በመንግስት ቁጥጥር ስር ያልነበሩ አካባቢዎችን ወደ ህግ ለማምጣት እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Iraaq Alii Al-Zaa'idii qorannoo seeraan alaa gurgurtaa boba'aa naannoo Jurf al-Nasr jedhamutti geggeeffame hordofee, hoggantoota nageenyaa fi boba'aa sagal hojiirraa ari'eera. Naannichi garee Iran gargaartu Katayib Hezbullaatiin to'atamu, siirichaa boba'aa biyyattii irraa boba'aa saamuuf rafiinarrii seeraan alaa fayyadamaa ture. Mootummaan namoota yakka kanaan shakkaman seeraatti dhiyeessaa jiraachuu fi naannoo duraan to'annoo mootummaa jala hin turre ammaa booda to'annoo jala oolchuuf murteesseera.

title: Netanyahu sends plea to Eisenkot for unity government
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has publicly asked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to join a unity government with his Likud Party. Eisenkot, who currently faces a December 6 deadline to finalize his own government plans, has rejected the offer. He labeled the Prime Minister's request as a deceptive tactic rather than a genuine political proposal.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት ከሊኩድ ፓርቲያቸው ጋር በመቀላቀል አንድነት መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። እስከ ታህሳስ 6 መንግስት የመመስረት ጊዜ ያላቸው አይዘንኮት ይህንን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገውታል። የተቃዋሚው መሪ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩን ጥሪ እንደ ማታለያ ስልት በመቁጠር እውነተኛ የመደራደር ፍላጎት የሌለው መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu gaggeessaa mormitootaa Gaadii Ayizankoot waliin mootummaa tokkummaa akka hundeessan gaafataniru. Ayizankoot hanga Muddee 6 tti mootummaa hundeessuuf yeroo qaban keessatti, gaaffii Netaaniyaahuu kana fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Ayizankoot yaada mummichi ministeerichaa dhiyeessan kun kan dhugaa irraa fagaate fi mala xaxaa kan qabu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Thailand’s elderly kept in cages
english: A nursing home in Thailand is facing serious allegations for confining elderly residents inside metal cages. This disturbing situation highlights the growing struggle to provide affordable and humane care for the country's rapidly aging population. As the number of senior citizens continues to rise, the lack of accessible eldercare resources has become a pressing national concern.
amharic: በታይላንድ የሚገኝ አንድ አረጋውያን ማቆያ ጣቢያ፣ አረጋውያንን በብረት ቤት ውስጥ በመቆለፍ እየተከሰሰ ይገኛል። ይህ አስደንጋጭ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የአረጋውያን ቁጥር ተከትሎ ተገቢና ተመጣጣኝ የሆነ የእንክብካቤ አገልግሎት ማግኘት አስቸጋሪ እየሆነ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። አረጋውያን እየበዙ በመምጣታቸው፣ በቂ የመንከባከቢያ አቅርቦት እጥረት አሳሳቢ የሀገር አቀፍ ችግር ሆኗል።
oromo: Buufanni maanguddoota kunuunsu tokko kan Thaayilaand keessatti argamu, maanguddoota keessatti argaman keeyyoo sibiilaa keessatti hidhuun himatameera. Haalli kun akkaataa maanguddoota baay'ataa jiran kanaaf kunuunsa gaarii fi gatii madaala qabu dhiyeessuun itti rakkisaa dhufe agarsiisa. Lakkoofsi maanguddootaa dabalaa waan jiruuf, qabeenya maanguddoota kunuunsuuf gargaaru dhabamuun rakkoo biyyoolessaa cimaa ta'eera.

title: Tsadkan’s “Reforms” Have Fragmented Tigray’s Unity
english: The political campaign led by General Tsadkan Gebretensae and his allies to dismantle the TPLF has caused significant division within Tigray, weakening the region’s unity during a time of recovery. By aligning with federal forces to challenge the TPLF, this faction has alienated parts of the population and deepened historical regional conflicts. Ultimately, these political maneuvers have prioritized internal power struggles over addressing the urgent humanitarian needs and collective trauma of the Tigrayan people.
amharic: ጄኔራል ጻድቃን ገብረትንሳይ እና አጋሮቻቸው ህወሓትን ለማዳከም ያደረጉት የፖለቲካ እንቅስቃሴ በትግራይ ህዝብ መካከል መከፋፈልን በመፍጠር የክልሉን አንድነት አናግቶታል። ይህ ቡድን ህወሓትን ለመቃወም ከፌዴራል ኃይሎች ጋር በመተባበሩ፣ የክልሉን የውስጥ ሰላም ከመጉዳቱም በላይ የቆዩ የክልል ግጭቶችን ዳግም አቀጣጥሏል። በመጨረሻም፣ እነዚህ የፖለቲካ ሽኩቻዎች የክልሉን ህዝብ አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ ችግሮች ከመፍታት ይልቅ ለስልጣን ሽኩቻ ቅድሚያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: General Tsadkan Gebretensae fi degartootni isaa sochiin siyaasaa 'TPLF' diiguuf godhan, tokkummaa Tigraay irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira. Gareen kun TPLF mormuuf humnoota federaalaa waliin hiriiruun, ummata gidduutti walqoodinsa uumuu fi walitti bu'iinsa kutaalee biyyaa durii deebisee kaaseera. Walumaagalatti, tarkaanfiiwwan siyaasaa kun rakkoowwan namoomaa fi miidhaa garaa garaa ummata Tigraay irra ga'e furuu irra, dhimma aangoof wal dorgomuu irratti xiyyeeffataniiru.

title: Ethiopian Airlines Swaps an Air Force General for a Party Leader
english: Adem Farah, the vice president of the Prosperity Party, has been appointed as the new chairperson of the Ethiopian Airlines Group Board of Directors. He replaces Lieutenant General Yilma Merdassa, the head of the Ethiopian Air Force, who had held the position since June 2023. This leadership change marks a shift back to civilian management for the airline's board after three years of military oversight.
amharic: የብልጽግና ፓርቲ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት አደም ፋራህ የኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ ግሩፕ ቦርድ ሊቀመንበር ሆነው ተሾመዋል። እርሳቸው የተተኩት ከሰኔ 2015 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በቦርዱ ሊቀመንበርነት ሲያገለግሉ የቆዩትን የአየር ኃይል አዛዥ ሌተና ጀነራል ይልማ መርዳሳን ነው። ይህ የቦርድ አመራር ለውጥ የኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ ከሶስት ዓመት የጦር መኮንን አመራር በኋላ ወደ ሲቪል አመራር መመለሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Itti aantuun paartii badhaadhinaa Adem Farah itti gaafatamaa boordii dhaabbata geejjiba qilleensaa Itoophiyaa ta'uun muudamaniiru. Isaanis qondaala olaanaa raayyaa ittisaa irraa gara aangoo kanaa kan dhufan Leetenant Jeneraal Yilma Merdassa bakka bu'aniiru. Jijjiiramni kun boordiin dhaabbatichaa waggoota sadii booda qondaala waraanaa irraa gara hogganaa siviiliitti akka deebi'u taasiseera.

title: The Numbers on Inflation Ease, Households Still Pay More
english: Although official government data suggests the economy is growing, ordinary households continue to struggle with the rising cost of living. Many individuals and families report that their income is failing to keep up with the steep increase in rent and basic daily expenses. Despite official reports of easing inflation, the reality for most citizens is a significant financial burden that outweighs the country's paper gains.
amharic: የመንግስት ኦፊሴላዊ መረጃዎች ኢኮኖሚው እያደገ መሆኑን ቢጠቁሙም፣ ተራው ህዝብ ግን በከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነት እየተፈተነ ይገኛል። ብዙ ግለሰቦችና ቤተሰቦች የገቢ መጠናቸው ከቤት ኪራይና ከዕለት ተዕለት ፍጆታዎች የዋጋ ጭማሪ ጋር እኩል መሄድ እንደተሳነው ይገልጻሉ። የዋጋ ግሽበት መቀነሱን የሚያሳዩ መረጃዎች ቢኖሩም፣ በዕለት ተዕለት ህይወት ውስጥ ያለው የዋጋ ንረት ለብዙዎች ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaasni mootummaa dinagdeen biyyattii guddachaa jiraachuu ibsus, maatiin hundi garuu gatii jireenyaa olka'aa ta'een rakachaa jiru. Namoonni hedduu fi maatiin mindaan isaanii kiree manaa fi baasii guyyaa guyyaa waliin gahuu dhabuu isaanii dubbatu. Gatiin meeshaalee hir'achaa jiraachuu kan himamu ta'us, dhugaan jiru garuu baasiin jireenyaa miindaa isaanii caalee harka qalleeyyi irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumee jira.

title: Bank Chiefs to Head to Ideological Classes, Summoned by the Regulator
english: Leaders of commercial banks in Ethiopia have been instructed by the national financial regulator to attend ideological training sessions organized by the ruling Prosperity Party. These sessions are designed to align bank executives with the political vision of the administration. This directive highlights the government's increasing efforts to influence the management of private and state-run financial institutions.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ንግድ ባንኮች ፕሬዚዳንቶች እና ምክትል ፕሬዚዳንቶች በገዢው ብልጽግና ፓርቲ የተዘጋጀ የስልጠና መርሃ ግብር ላይ እንዲገኙ በቁጥጥር አካል ታዝዘዋል። ይህ ስልጠና የባንክ አመራሮችን ከመንግስት የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ጋር ለማቀናጀት ያለመ ነው። ይህም መንግስት በፋይናንስ ተቋማት ላይ ያለውን ተፅዕኖ ለማጠናከር እየሰራ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni baankiiwwan daldala Itoophiyaa qajeelfama qaama to'ataa mootummaan gara leenjii ideolojii kan paartii badhaadhinaa dhaabbate akka dhaqan ajajamanii jiru. Leenjichi hoggantoota baankiiwwanii yaad-rimee siyaasaa mootummaa wajjin walitti fiduuf kan qophaaye dha. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan dhaabbilee faayinaansii irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf yaalii gochaa jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Climate Conference Brings a State Rival to Premium Car Hire Market
english: Ethiopian Investment Holdings has launched Shabeel Fleets Enterprise to provide high-end transportation and logistics services for summit delegations. The company will focus on offering professional chauffeur services and coordinating event logistics. While the state-run sovereign fund started this initiative, specific details regarding the fleet size, total investment, and potential contracts remain undisclosed.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ኢንቨስትመንት ሆልዲንግስ ለስብሰባ ልዑካን የላቀ የትራንስፖርት እና የሎጂስቲክስ አገልግሎት ለመስጠት 'ሻቤል ፍሊትስ ኢንተርፕራይዝ' የተሰኘ ኩባንያ አቋቁሟል። ድርጅቱ በዋናነት ለከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት የማመላለሻ እና የዝግጅት አስተባባሪ አገልግሎቶችን ለመስጠት ታቅዶ የተቋቋመ ነው። የመንግስት የልማት ድርጅት ይህንን ቢጀምርም፣ ስለ ተሽከርካሪዎቹ ብዛት፣ ስለ ኢንቨስትመንቱ መጠን እና ስለ ኮንትራት ዝርዝሮች እስካሁን ይፋ የተደረገ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Qabeenya Investimantii Itoophiyaa ergamoota walga'iiwwaniif tajaajila geejjibaa fi loojistikii ammayyaa ta'e dhiyeessuuf dhaabbata 'Shabeel Fleets Enterprise' jedhamu hundeesseera. Dhaabbatichi tajaajila konkolaachisaa ogeessotaa fi qindeessuu qophiiwwan adda addaa irratti xiyyeeffata. Mootummaan dhaabbata kana kan hundeesse ta'us, baay'ina konkolaattotaa, baajata ramadame fi waliigaltee dhimma kanaa irratti odeeffannoon bal'aan ammaaf hin kennamne.

title: New Amhara Bank Case Alleges 200m Br Loan on Phantom Trucks
english: Federal prosecutors have charged a former Amhara Bank manager, Mesfin Getachew, and a client, Chalachew Taye, with corruption and fraud. The case involves an alleged 200 million Birr loan secured by non-existent trucks. Both suspects have been detained since October following an investigation by the Addis Abeba Police Commission.
amharic: የፌደራል አቃቤ ህግ የቀድሞ የአማራ ባንክ ስራ አስኪያጅ መስፍን ጌታቸው እና ደንበኛቸው ቻላቸው ታዬ ላይ በሙስና እና በማጭበርበር ወንጀል ክስ መስርቷል። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ ባልነበሩ የጭነት መኪናዎች ስም 200 ሚሊዮን ብር ብድር ወስደዋል ተብለው ተከሰውል። በአዲስ አበባ ፖሊስ ኮሚሽን በተደረገ ምርመራ ተጠርጣሪዎቹ ከጥቅምት ወር ጀምሮ በእስር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa federalaa, maanejarri duraanii Baanki Amharaa Mesfin Geetachoo fi maamiltoon isaa Chalachoo Taayee irratti himata malaammaltummaa fi gowwoomsuu dhiyeesseera. Himannaan kun liqii qarshii miiliyoona 200 kan ta'u, konkolaattota hin jirre fayyadamuun fudhatamee ture kan jedhu dha. Shakkamtoonni kunniin qorannoo Komishinii Poolisii Finfinneetiin booda ji'a Sadaasaa irraa eegalee hidhaa keessa jiru.

title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
english: A nationwide flight suspension across the US was triggered by technical errors during a project to replace outdated copper wiring with fiber optics. Transport Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed the incident was not a cyber-attack, though officials are investigating whether the disruption was caused by equipment failure or contractor error. This event led to thousands of cancellations and delays, marking the most significant disruption to American air travel since the September 11 attacks.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የተከሰተው የሀገር አቀፍ የበረራ መስተጓጎል የድሮውን የመዳብ ገመድ በፋይበር ኦፕቲክስ ለመቀየር በተደረገ የቴክኖሎጂ ማሻሻያ ወቅት በተፈጠረ ስህተት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። የትራንስፖርት ሚኒስትሩ ሾን ዳፊ ጉዳዩ የሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆኑን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ ችግሩ በመሳሪያዎች ብልሽት ወይስ በኮንትራክተሩ ስህተት እንደተፈጠረ ምርመራ እየተደረገ ነው። ይህ ክስተት ከሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት በኋላ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ሁኔታ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎችን በመሰረዝ እና በማዘግየት በሀገሪቱ የአየር ትራንስፖርት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hojiin bu'uraalee gamtoominaa fi quunnamtii ammayyeessuuf jecha ergoo sibiilaa (copper wire) gara fayibar optiksitti jijjiiruuf godhame, guutummaa Ameerikaa keessatti balallii xiyyaaraa akka dhaabatu godheera. Ministirri Dhimma Geejjibaa, Sean Duffy akka ibsanitti, rakkoon kun hojii sana irratti uumame malee miidhaa haxxee (cyber-attack) miti; ta'us, rakkoon kun meeshaalee fiixuu dhabuu moo dogoggora dhaabbata hojicha geggeessaa ture irraa akka dhufe qorannoon irratti godhamaa jira. Mudannoon kun erga weerara garaa garaa bara 2001 booda kanneen biroo caalaa balallii xiyyaaraa miidhuun, kumaan lakkaawwaman akka haaqaman fi turan godheera.

title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
english: Italian regulators have penalized Meta with an 805 million euro fine for accessing Android users' photos without clear permission. The authority found that Meta failed to properly inform nearly 20 million users that a Facebook feature was scanning their personal image galleries to suggest social media posts. The company has been ordered to disable this feature by default within two months and must obtain explicit consent from users, though Meta intends to challenge the ruling.
amharic: የጣሊያን ተቆጣጣሪ አካላት ሜታ የተባለውን ኩባንያ የአንድሮይድ ተጠቃሚዎችን ፎቶዎች ያለ በቂ ፈቃድ በመጠቀሙ 805 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ ቀጥተዋል። ኩባንያው ወደ 20 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ተጠቃሚዎች የፌስቡክ አፕሊኬሽን የግል ፎቶዎቻቸውን ለፖስት ሃሳብነት እንደሚጠቀም በግልፅ አለማሳወቁ ተረጋግጧል። በሁለት ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ ይህን ባህሪ በነባሪነት እንዲያቆም እና ከተጠቃሚዎች ግልጽ ፈቃድ እንዲያገኝ የታዘዘ ሲሆን፣ ሜታ ግን ውሳኔውን እንደሚቃወም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Xaaliyaanii dhaabbata Meetaa fayyadamtoota Android fedhii isaanii malee suuraa isaanii waan qorateef yeroo 805 miiliyoona Yuuroo akka kaffalu dirqisiiseera. Dhaabbatichi fayyadamtoota miiliyoona 20 ta'anitti appilikeeshiniin Facebook suuraa isaanii gorsa postii godhachuuf akka fayyadamu ifatti hin himne. Meetaan suuraa kana gosa 'default' ta'een kutaachuu fi fayyadamtoota irraa hayyama sirrii ta'e argachuu akka qabu ajajameera, ta'us dhaabbatichi murtii kana irratti ol-iyyannoo galfachuu akka qabu ibseera.

title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
english: Nineteen-year-old singer Carmelle from the Philippines has won the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia held in Bangkok. She secured the victory with her empowering track 'Sobra-Sobra,' earning top marks from both the professional jury and the public audience. The competition featured eleven different countries and concluded with Thailand taking second place and Vietnam placing third.
amharic: ከፊሊፒንስ የተወጣችው የ19 ዓመቷ ድምጻዊት ካርሜል ባንኮክ በተካሄደው የመጀመሪያው የእስያ የዩሮቪዥን ዘፈን ውድድር አሸናፊ ሆናለች። ካርሜል ድሉን ያገኘችው 'ሶብራ-ሶብራ' በተሰኘው የሴቶች አቅምን የሚያጎለብት ዘፈኗ ሲሆን ከዳኞችም ሆነ ከህዝብ ከፍተኛ ድምጽ አግኝታለች። በውድድሩ 11 ሀገራት የተሳተፉ ሲሆን ታይላንድ በሁለተኛነት፣ ቬትናም ደግሞ በሶስተኛነት ተቀምጠዋል።
oromo: Weellistuun umurii waggaa 19 kan taate Carmelle jedhamtu biyya Filippiinsii irraa dhuftu, dorgommii muuziqaa Euroovizhen Eeshiyaa kan jalqabaa Baangkookitti gaggeeffame injifatteetti. Carmelle injifannoo kana kan gonfatte sirba 'Sobra-Sobra' jedhamu kan dubartoota jajjabeessuun yoo ta'u, abbootii murtii fi ummata biraa sagalee olaanaa argatteetti. Dorgommichi biyyoota 11 kan hirmaachise yoo ta'u, Taayilaandi lammaffaa, Veetinaamis sadaffaa ta'uun xumurameera.

title: Can being ‘non-Western’ cost you your home in Denmark?
english: Denmark's Supreme Court is currently reviewing a controversial policy that classifies residents as either 'Western' or 'non-Western.' This legal debate focuses on whether the government has the right to force families out of their homes based on these demographic labels. Affected residents are now challenging these evictions in court, arguing against the fairness of the housing legislation.
amharic: የዴንማርክ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ነዋሪዎችን እንደ 'ምዕራባዊ' እና 'ምዕራባዊ ያልሆነ' በሚል የሚከፋፍለውን አወዛጋቢ ህግ እየመረመረ ይገኛል። ክርክሩ በዋነኝነት የሚያተኩረው መንግስት በእነዚህ መለያዎች ላይ ተመስርቶ ቤተሰቦችን ከቤታቸው የማፈናቀል መብት አለው ወይ የሚለው ላይ ነው። የተጎዱ ነዋሪዎችም ይህ የቤቶች ህግ ፍትሃዊ አይደለም በማለት በህግ እየተከራከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa kan Deenmaarkitti, namoota akka 'Lixaa' fi 'Lixaa hin taane'tti gargar qoqqooduun seerota murteessaa jiru irratti mari'achaa jira. Falmiin kun mootummaan gargar baasuun kana irratti hundaa'ee maatiiwwan mana isaanii irraa buqqisuu mirga qabaa jedhu irratti xiyyeeffata. Jiraattonni miidhaan irra ga'e, seeronni manaa kun walqixxummaa kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsuun mana murtiitti falmachaa jiru.

title: Deadly car bomb blast kills two near Syria’s capital
english: A car bomb explosion in the town of Jaramana, located near the Syrian capital of Damascus, has resulted in the deaths of two people, including a man and a young girl. Following the attack, local security forces quickly secured the site to prevent further harm. Authorities have initiated a formal investigation to determine the circumstances behind the blast.
amharic: ሶሪያ ዋና ከተማ ደማስቆ አቅራቢያ በምትገኝ ጃራማና በተባለች ከተማ በደረሰ የመኪና ቦምብ ጥቃት አንድ ወንድ እና አንዲት ህጻን ልጅ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ የጸጥታ ሃይሎች አካባቢውን በመቆጣጠር ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ በቦምብ ፍንዳታው ዙሪያ ሰፊ ማጣራት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa Siiriyaa Daamaasqoos biratti argamtu, Jaaramanaa jedhamtutti konkolaataa keessa fashaleen boombii lammiilee lama, dhiira tokko fi intala xiqqoo tokko ajjeeseera. Erga miidhaan kun qaqqabee booda, humnoonni nageenyaa naannichatti argamuun qorannoo eegaleera. Mootummaan sababa fi namoota yakka kana raawwatan adda baasuuf qorannoo bal’aa geggeessaa jira.

title: More than 100,000 rally across France in new Yellow Vest protests
english: Over 100,000 demonstrators marched across France to protest rising living costs, low wages, and government policies. While the nationwide turnout was lower than in previous weeks, clashes involving tear gas occurred in several major cities. Protesters also expressed strong dissatisfaction with President Macron and announced plans for further strikes following the rejection of a proposed wage increase.
amharic: ከ100,000 በላይ ሰልፈኞች በፈረንሳይ የኑሮ ውድነትን፣ ዝቅተኛ ደመወዝን እና የመንግስትን ፖሊሲዎች በመቃወም ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። በአገሪቱ አቀፍ ደረጃ የተሳታፊዎች ቁጥር ከቀደምት ሳምንታት አንጻር ቀንሶ ቢታይም፣ በተለያዩ ዋና ዋና ከተሞች የፖሊስ አስለቃሽ ጭስ መጠቀሙን ተከትሎ ግጭቶች ተከስተዋል። ሰልፈኞቹ በፕሬዚዳንት ማክሮን ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ መንግስት ያቀረበውን አነስተኛ የደመወዝ ጭማሪ በመቃወም በቀጣይ አድማ እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Namoonni 100,000 ol ta'an Faransaay keessatti gatii jireenyaa olka'e, mindaa xiqqaa fi imaammata mootummaa mormuun hiriira bahaniiru. Hiriirtonni kunneen haala guyyoota darban irra xiqqataa dhufeen illee, magaalonni gurguddoon tokko tokko walitti bu'insaafi fayyadama gaazii imimmaansuu agartaniiru. Hiriirtonni prezidaant Maakroon irratti mormii cimaa kan agarsiisan yoo ta'u, mootummaan mindaa dabaluuf waadaa gale fudhatama dhabeera jedhanii, gara fuulduraatti deemsa sochii fi kottoonfannaa (strike) itti fufuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Tens of thousands march in latest Portugal housing protests
english: Tens of thousands of people across Portugal recently marched in over 30 cities to demand government action against the country's severe housing crisis. Protesters are calling for rent caps, better tenant protections, and stricter regulations on short-term rentals, citing that housing costs have drastically outpaced local wages. This movement, the largest of its kind, opposes recent legislative changes that they fear will make it easier for landlords to evict tenants and increase costs.
amharic: በፖርቱጋል በሚገኙ ከ30 በላይ ከተሞች በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች በሀገሪቱ የከፋ የመኖሪያ ቤት ችግር ላይ የመንግስትን እርምጃ በመጠየቅ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የቤት ኪራይ ዋጋ እንዲወሰን፣ የተከራዮች መብት እንዲጠበቅ እና ለአጭር ጊዜ ኪራዮች ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል። የኑሮ ውድነቱ ከደመወዝ ጭማሪ ጋር ያልተመጣጠነ መሆኑን የገለጹት ሰልፈኞቹ፣ በቅርቡ በፓርላማ የጸደቁት አዳዲስ ህጎች ተከራዮችን ለችግር እንደሚዳርጉ በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Purtugaal keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman magaaloolee 30 ol keessatti hiriira guddaa ba’uun rakkoo mana jireenyaa biyyattii keessatti mul’atuuf furmaata akka kennamu mootummaa gaafataniiru. Hiriirtonni kun gatii kiree mana jireenyaa irratti daangaan akka kaa’amu, mirgi kireeffattootaa akka kabajamuufi qajeelfamoonni kiree manaa jabaachuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru. Gatiin mana jireenyaa mindaa hojjettootaa caalaa dabaluu isaa kan morman hiriirtonni kun, seeronni haaraa mana kiree ilaalchisee ba’an kireeffattoota miidhuu akka danda’an ibsaniiru.

title: Pope Leo urges end to violence in Peru during visit to remote Andes town
english: Pope Leo XIV recently visited Peru, where he called for an end to the rising violence and criminality affecting the nation. During his visit to an Andean town, he encouraged citizens to combat injustice through patience, prayer, and persistent action rather than brutality. He also highlighted the hardships faced by rural communities, noting that many people are leaving their homes due to economic instability and social challenges.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በፔሩ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኃይል ጥቃት እና ወንጀል እንዲቆም ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በአንዲት የአንዲስ ከተማ ባደረጉት ጉብኝት፣ ህዝቡ ኢፍትሐዊነትን በኃይል ከመመከት ይልቅ በትዕግስት እና በጸሎት እንዲወጡ መክረዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በገጠር አካባቢዎች የሚገኙ ማህበረሰቦች በኢኮኖሚ ችግር እና በማህበራዊ ጫና ምክንያት መንደሮቻቸውን ለቀው ለመሰደድ መገደዳቸውን አንስተዋል።
oromo: Papaa Leewoo 14ffaan biyya Peeruu keessatti gochaa jeequmsaafi yakka biyyattii mudate dhaabsisuuf waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Magaalaa naannoo Andesitti yeroo dubbatan, lammiileen immoo haqaa dhabuu irratti humnaan deebii kennuu mannaa, obsaafi kadhannaan jijjiirama fiduu akka qaban gorfaniiru. Kana malees, ummanni baadiyyaa hiyyummaafi rakkoo jiru irraa kan ka'e, mana isaanii dhiisanii gara magaalotaatti godaanuun isaanii akka isaan yaaddessu ibsaniiru.

title: John Fetterman threatens to quit Democratic Party if next Senate leader is critical of Israel
english: Senator John Fetterman has warned that he might leave the Democratic Party if his colleagues elect a Senate leader who is critical of Israel. Fetterman specifically expressed opposition to Senator Chris Van Hollen, who is seeking the leadership role and has been vocal about the humanitarian crisis in Gaza. This stance highlights the deep divisions within the party regarding their approach to Israel and its policies.
amharic: ሴናተር ጆን ፌተርማን የእስራኤልን ፖሊሲ የሚቃወም ሰው የሴኔት መሪ ሆኖ ከተመረጠ ከዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ሊለቁ እንደሚችሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ፌተርማን በተለይም ለሴኔት መሪነት እየተወዳደሩ ያሉትን እና በጋዛ ስላለው የሰብአዊ ሁኔታ ተቃውሞ ሲያሰሙ የቆዩትን ሴናተር ክሪስ ቫን ሆለንን እንደሚቃወሙ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት በእስራኤል ጉዳይ ላይ በፓርቲው ውስጥ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ልዩነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Senator John Fetterman qaama hogganaa seeneetii kan ta'e yoo Israa'elitti qeeqa dhiyeesse paartii Dimookraatikii keessaa ba'uu akka danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Fetterman keessattuu Senator Chris Van Hollen kan hogganummaa barbaadan fi haala namoomaa Gaaza irratti qeeqa qaban mormuusaanii ibseera. Ta'uun kun dhimma Israa'el irratti paarticha keessatti yaada wal-dhabdee jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Hamas calls for urgent repairs to Gaza’s sewage and drainage systems
english: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya is demanding immediate repairs to Gaza's sanitation and drainage infrastructure following severe flooding that destroyed numerous tents used by displaced people. He criticized Israel's ongoing restrictions on fuel and essential supplies, which are preventing necessary reconstruction efforts. Al-Hayya described the situation as a deliberate policy of starvation and destruction, calling for unrestricted access for humanitarian aid organizations.
amharic: የሃማስ የፖለቲካ ቢሮ ኃላፊ ካሊል አል-ሃያ በጋዛ የጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ለተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ የሆኑትን ድንኳኖች ካወደመ በኋላ፣ የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃዎችን በአስቸኳይ እንዲጠግኑ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። እስራኤል በጋዛ ላይ የጣለችው የነዳጅ እና የምግብ እገዳ መሰረተ ልማቶችን ለመጠገን እንቅፋት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። አል-ሃያ አሁን ያለው ሁኔታ የጦርነት ውጤት ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጠረ የረሃብ እና የውድመት ፖሊሲ በመሆኑ፣ የሰብአዊ ድርጅቶች ያለ ገደብ እርዳታ እንዲያቀርቡ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Hamaas Khalil al-Hayya, rooba cimaa magaalaa Gaazaatti roobeen dunkaanonni baqattootaa miidhamuu hordofee, sirni dhangala'aa bishaanii fi dhangala'aan magaalaa sun saffisaan akka suphamu gaafataniiru. Innis Israa'el gargaarsa namoomaa fi boba'aa irratti uggura kaa'uun ishee, hojii haaromsaa gufachiisuu ishee balaaleffateera. Al-Hayya haalli amma jiru kun balaa tasaa osoo hin taane, tarsiimoo beelaa fi badiisaa qormaata ta'e waan ta'eef, dhaabbileen gargaarsaa ittigaafatamummaa guutuun akka galan gaafataniiru.

title: Houthis report 72 Saudi-led coalition air strikes across Yemen
english: A Houthi spokesperson announced that the Saudi-led coalition conducted 72 aerial attacks across four Yemeni provinces within a single day. These strikes are part of a broader military campaign that has seen over 5,000 combined air and missile attacks since the summer. The announcement highlights a significant intensification in the ongoing conflict in the region.
amharic: የሁቲ ወታደራዊ ቃል አቀባይ እንዳስታወቁት፣ በሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ በአራት የየመን ግዛቶች ላይ 72 የአየር ጥቃቶችን አድርሷል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በበጋው ወቅት ግጭቶች እንደገና ከተቀሰቀሱ ወዲህ ከተፈጸሙ ከ5,000 በላይ የአየር እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች አካል ናቸው። ይህ መግለጫ በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan waraana Huutii akka ibsetti, gamtaan Sa'udii durfamu guyyaa tokko keessatti naannolee Yaman afur keessatti 72 irra deddeebi'anii haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun gannaa darbe erga waraanni deebi'ee jalqabee as, haleellaa qilleensaa fi meeshaa waraana gurguddaa walitti qabamee 5,000 ol ta'u keessaa tokko dha. Ibsi kun naannichatti waraanni amma jiru sadarkaa olaanaatti cehuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Saudi Arabia executes former child protester Jawad Qureiris
english: Saudi Arabia has executed Jawad Qureiris, a man who was arrested for his participation in protests when he was a child. Alongside another individual, he was convicted of various terrorism-related charges, though his family and human rights groups maintain he was tortured into giving false confessions. These executions mark the fifth case since 2025 involving individuals put to death for actions taken during their youth.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በልጅነታቸው በተሳተፉበት ተቃውሞ የታሰሩትን ጃዋድ ቁሬይሪስን ጨምሮ ሁለት ሰዎችን በሞት ቀጥታለች። መንግስት ሁለቱንም ግለሰቦች በሽብርተኝነት ወንጀል ከሷቸዋል፤ ቤተሰቦቻቸው እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን ግለሰቦቹ በስቃይ የተሞላበት ምርመራ በማድረግ የተሳሳተ የእምነት ቃል እንዲሰጡ ተደርገዋል ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ክስተት ከ2025 ወዲህ በልጅነታቸው በፈጸሙት ተብሎ በተከሰሰ ወንጀል በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሞት ፍርድ የተፈረደባቸው አምስተኛው ጉዳይ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan Jawad Qureiris nama yeroo ijoollummaa isaa hiriira irratti hirmaateef hidhamee ture ajjeesteetti. Namni kun fi nama biraa tokko yakka shororkeessummaan himatamanis, maatiin isaanii fi dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa akka himatanitti, namoonni kunneen dhiphina qaamaa fi sammuu irratti raawwatameef jiruun dhara akka amanan taasisaniiru. Ajjeechaan kun, bara 2025 irraa eegalee namoota yeroo ijoollummaatti yakka raawwataniiru jedhamanii mootumichaan ajjeefaman keessaa shanaffaadha.

title: ‘Loss of confidence’: US Navy fires commanders of warships deployed against Iran
english: The US Navy has removed several high-ranking officers from their posts, including leaders of the USS South Dakota submarine and the USS Michael Murphy destroyer, due to issues like performance concerns and accidents. This move has sparked controversy because the Navy did not officially announce the removals or notify Congress in a timely manner. Lawmakers are now questioning the military's transparency, particularly regarding how information about regional tensions and potential damage from conflicts with Iran is being managed.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል የዩኤስኤስ ሳውዝ ዳኮታ ሰርጓጅ መርከብን እና የዩኤስኤስ ማይክል መርፊ አጥፊ መርከብን ጨምሮ በርካታ ከፍተኛ መኮንኖችን ከኃላፊነታቸው አንስቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ ይፋዊ መግለጫ ሳይሰጥ እና ለኮንግረስ ሳይገለጽ መደረጉ የህግ አውጪዎችን ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። በዚህም ሳቢያ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አመራር ግልጽነት እና ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ውጥረት ዙሪያ መረጃን ስለማስተዳደር ያላቸው አሰራር ከፍተኛ ጥያቄ ውስጥ ወድቋል።
oromo: Humni galaana Amerikaa (US Navy) ajajoota olaanoo muraasa, kanneen akka hogganoota markaba lolaa 'USS South Dakota' fi 'USS Michael Murphy' hojii irraa ari'eera. Murteen kun ibsa ifaa malee fi mana maree biyyattii (Congress) osoo hin beeksisin fudhatamuu isaatiin mormii cimaa uumeera. Kana irraa kan ka'e, mootummaan Amerikaa ibsa kennuu irratti qabanuufi dhimmoota nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa Iraan wajjin jiru irratti odeeffannoo haguuguu isaaniitiin qeeqa gurguddaa mudachaa jiru.

title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that US negotiators have proposed a potential deal where Ukraine would give up control of the Donbas region in exchange for joining NATO. While Kyiv has historically refused to cede sovereign territory, Zelensky indicated he would consider putting a comprehensive peace plan to a public vote if it included strong security guarantees. Despite these discussions, Russia's demands for neutrality and territorial control remain largely unchanged, leaving the path to a resolution uncertain.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ እንደገለጹት የአሜሪካ የድርድር ቡድን ዩክሬን የዶንባስ ክልልን በመልቀቅ በምትኩ የኔቶ አባል እንድትሆን ሀሳብ አቅርበዋል። ዩክሬን ግዛቷን አሳልፎ ለመስጠት ፈቃደኛ ባትሆንም፣ ዘለንስኪ አስተማማኝ የደህንነት ዋስትናዎችን የያዘ አጠቃላይ የሰላም ስምምነት ቢቀርብላቸው ለህዝብ ውሳኔ ሊያቀርቡት እንደሚችሉ ጠቁመዋል። ምንም እንኳን የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች ቢኖሩም፣ የሩሲያ የግዛት እና የገለልተኝነት ፍላጎቶች ሳይቀየሩ በመቆየታቸው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት መፍትሄ አሁንም አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski akka jedhanitti, bakka bu’oonni Ameerikaa Yukreen naannoo Donbaas gadi lhiistee miseensa NATO ta’uu akka dandeessu yaada dhiyeessaniiru. Yukreen guutummaatti biyyee ishee gadi lhiisuu kan hin barbaanne ta’us, Zeelenski waadaa nageenyaa cimaa qabu yoo ta’e, yaada kana irratti uummanni akka murteessu gochuu akka danda’u ibsaniiru. Haa ta’u malee, Rashiyaan naannoo fi dirqama loogummaa malee jiraachuu (neutrality) ilaalchisee fedhii qabdu jijjiiramuu dhabuun ishee, xumura waraana kanaa kan shakkisiisu ta’eera.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli forces occupy Palestinian-American’s home
english: Israeli military forces seized control of a home belonging to a Palestinian-American in the occupied West Bank for over two weeks. During the same period, soldiers interrupted a Palestinian wedding ceremony to take the groom into custody. These incidents occurred alongside ongoing and lethal Israeli military operations throughout the Gaza Strip.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኝ የአንድ ፍልስጤማዊ-አሜሪካዊ መኖሪያ ቤትን ለ17 ቀናት ተቆጣጥረውት ነበር። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ወታደሮቹ በፈጸሙት ወረራ አንድ የፍልስጤም ሰርግ ላይ በመግባት ሙሽራውን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በተከታታይ ገዳይ ጥቃቶች እየተፈጸሙበት ካለው የጋዛ ሰርጥ ሁኔታ ጋር ተያይዞ የተከሰቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnootni waraana Israa'el mana lammii Palestiinii kan ta'e kan Ameerikaa jiru tokko naannoo Waan Baankitti guyyoota 17f qabatanii turan. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, waraanni kun cidha tokko gidduutti seenuun misirrichicha hidhaniiru. Gochi kunis haleellaa waraana Israa'el kan gaazaatti guyyaa guyyaan gaggeeffamaa jiru waliin kan wal qabatu dha.

title: NASA’s Voyager 1 to hit new space distance record of one light-day
english: NASA's Voyager 1 probe is set to become the first human-made object to reach a distance of one light-day from Earth. Launched in 1977, the spacecraft continues to provide valuable scientific data while traveling through interstellar space. Although mission engineers are managing communication challenges, the probe remains a historic achievement in space exploration.
amharic: የናሳው የቮዬጀር 1 የጠፈር መርማሪ ከምድር አንድ የብርሃን ቀን ርቀት ላይ የሚደርስ የመጀመሪያው ሰው ሰራሽ ዕቃ ሊሆን ነው። በ1977 የተጀመረው ይህ መርማሪ በከዋክብት መካከል ባለው ክፍተት ውስጥ እየተጓዘ ጠቃሚ ሳይንሳዊ መረጃዎችን መላኩን ቀጥሏል። የናሳ መሐንዲሶች የመገናኛ ችግሮችን እየፈቱ ቢሆንም፣ የጠፈር መርማሪው በጠፈር ምርምር ታሪክ ውስጥ ትልቅ ስኬት ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Iskiriinjiin NASA Voyager 1 jedhamu meeshaa namaan hojjetamee lafarraa fagaatee guyyaa ifaa tokko (one light-day) gahuun jalqabaa ta'uuf jira. bara 1977 kan ergame kun, iddoo urjiilee gidduu jiru keessa socho'aa odeeffannoo saayinsii barbaachisaa ta'e gara lafaatti ergaa jira. Injineeronnii NASA rakkoolee qunnamtii mudatan furuuf tattaaffii godhaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, ergaa ergame kun seenaa qorannoo hawaa keessatti galmee guddaa qaba.

title: Canada’s Stelco to recall 175 workers after government pressure
english: The Canadian steelmaker Stelco has agreed to rehire 175 employees and provide them with back pay after the government threatened legal action against its US owner, Cleveland-Cliffs. The company had originally laid off the workers due to market challenges and trade tariffs, but officials argued this move broke previous employment commitments. This decision follows significant pressure from labor unions and the Canadian government, which insisted that the company must honor its promises to maintain local jobs.
amharic: የካናዳው ብረት አምራች ኩባንያ ስቴልኮ (Stelco)፣ የካናዳ መንግስት በባለቤቱ በአሜሪካው ክሊቭላንድ-ክሊፍስ ላይ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ ካስጠነቀቀ በኋላ፣ 175 ሰራተኞችን መልሶ ለመቅጠር እና የደመወዝ ክፍያቸውን ለማካካስ ተስማምቷል። ኩባንያው ሰራተኞቹን ያሰናበተው በገበያ ችግሮች እና በታሪፍ ምክንያት ቢሆንም፣ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል የገቡትን የቅጥር ቃል የጣሰ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የሰራተኛ ማህበራት እና የካናዳ መንግስት በኩባንያው ላይ ባደረጉት ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Warshaan sibiilaa kan Kaanaadaa Stelco jedhamu, mootummaan kan isaa kan ta'e Cleveland-Cliffs irratti tarkaanfii seeraa fudhachuuf erga doorsisee booda, hojjattoota 175 gara hojii deebisuufi kaffaltii kaffalamuu qabuufiif waliigaleera. Dhaabbatichi hojjattoota kana kan geggeesse rakkoo gabaafi gibira irratti hundaa'ee ta'us, mootummaan immoo tarkaanfiin kun waadaa kanaan dura seename kan cabse ta'uu ibse. Murteen kun dhiibbaa cimaa gamtaa hojjattootaafi mootummaa Kaanaadaa irraa isaaniif godhameen booda kan fudhatameedha.
